root_cause.text: In md RAID456, I/O requests that cross the reshape position sleep in wait_for_reshape while still holding an active_io reference, causing a deadlock when mddev_suspend() is called after the reshape thread is frozen, because the I/O never completes and never releases the reference, preventing suspend.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: "During raid456 reshape, direct IO across the reshape position can sleep in raid5_make_request() waiting for reshape progress while still holding an active_io reference. If userspace then freezes reshape and writes md/suspend_lo or md/suspend_hi, mddev_suspend() kills active_io and waits for all in-flight IO to drain. This can deadlock: the IO needs reshape progress to continue, but the reshape thread is already frozen, so the active_io reference is never dropped and suspend never completes." The patch adds a call to mddev->pers->prepare_suspend(mddev) in mddev_suspend() when reshape_interrupted(mddev) is true, to wake those waiters so they can abort and drop the reference.

intent_record.intent_summary: Prevent deadlock in mddev_suspend by calling prepare_suspend to wake RAID456 reshape waiters when reshape is interrupted.
intent_record.what: Added a call to mddev->pers->prepare_suspend(mddev) when reshape is interrupted, after percpu_ref_kill, with a comment explaining the deadlock scenario.
intent_record.how: Before waiting for active_io to become zero, the code now invokes the personality's prepare_suspend callback if reshape is interrupted, waking any IO waiting on reshape that holds an active_io reference, thus preventing a deadlock in the suspend path.
